hub.stack: Django, Django REST Framework, React, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Redis, Celery, S3-compatible storage, Docker Compose
hub.definition: Space Works is free, open-source, self-hosted management software for makerspaces, fab labs, hackerspaces and tool libraries. One install covers inventory and QR tool lending, machines and 3D printing, events, room bookings and memberships, for one space or many.
features: Public catalogue, borrow requests and QR check-out with photo evidence at every handover
Machine registry, certifications, service queue and 3D-printing requests with filament tracking
Events with registration, waitlists, offline QR check-in, badges and certificates
Bookable rooms and resources with recurring slots and calendar feeds
Personal accounts, membership plans and renewals, optional Stripe or Razorpay payments
Many makerspaces on one server, roles you define, an append-only audit log
Encrypted, signed backups and updates from GitHub releases with automatic rollback
